texts.zh: 在调查[From.GetName]时，[Root.GetName]的船员惊讶地发现小行星内部竟然出现了生命的迹象。某种穴居虫类无机体生命居住在被暗道遍布的岩石之中。这种独特的生命体似乎已经适应了太空的严寒。
texts.en: Amazingly, while conducting their survey of [From.GetName], the crew of the [Root.GetName] picked up several life signs coming from within the asteroid. There appears to be a colony of large burrowing worm-like lithovores within the rock, which has been riddled with tunnels. These unique life forms have somehow adapted to a life in the coldness of space.

label.zh: 应该好好研究一下这些生物。
